SELECT id, tenant_id, wa_id, phone_number, contact_id, lead_id, phone_number_id, last_message_at, last_message_preview, last_customer_message_at, last_outbound_at, unread_count, status, user_id, owner, assigned_at, hosted_by_ai, create_time, update_time FROM crm_whatsapp_conversation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, tenant_id, wa_id, phone_number, contact_id, lead_id, phone_number_id, last_message_at, last_message_preview, last_customer_message_at, last_outbound_at, unread_count, status, user_id, owner, assigned_at, hosted_by_ai, create_time, update_time FROM crm_whatsapp_conversation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND wa_id = #{waId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_whatsapp_conversation ( tenant_id, wa_id, phone_number, contact_id, lead_id, phone_number_id, last_message_at, last_message_preview, last_customer_message_at, last_outbound_at, unread_count, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{waId}, #{phoneNumber}, #{contactId}, #{leadId}, #{phoneNumberId}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{lastMessagePreview}, #{lastCustomerMessageAt}, #{lastOutboundAt}, COALESCE(#{unreadCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 'active'), #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, wa_id) DO UPDATE SET phone_number = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone_number, crm_whatsapp_conversation.phone_number), last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at, last_message_preview = EXCLUDED.last_message_preview, last_customer_message_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_customer_message_at, crm_whatsapp_conversation.last_customer_message_at), last_outbound_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_outbound_at, crm_whatsapp_conversation.last_outbound_at), unread_count = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.unread_count, crm_whatsapp_conversation.unread_count), update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_whatsapp_conversation SET user_id = #{userId}, owner = #{owner}, assigned_at = #{assignedAt}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE crm_whatsapp_conversation SET user_id = NULL, owner = NULL, assigned_at = NULL, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE crm_whatsapp_conversation SET hosted_by_ai = #{hostedByAi,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
